persona.name: Dalia Moreno

personality.description: This person tends to rely on familiar routines, established methods, and practical examples, and may be cautious about adopting new ideas unless they have clear proof of value. Their habits are usually moderately structured: they keep things reasonably organized, but can adapt when circumstances change. In moral dilemmas, they first look for the safest and most conventional course, weigh fairness against practicality, and will defend their own judgment if they believe it is justified. In group discussions, they speak in a balanced way—often listening first, contributing steadily, and becoming more firm and direct when their viewpoint is challenged.
traits: asks for clarification rather than assuming
gives an opinion when asked, briefly
goes along with a decision they did not personally push for

style.influence: Participates without trying to run the room. Contributes when they have something to add and is content to let others set direction.

speech_examples: Can you say more about that?
I'm not sure we've ruled out the other option.
